summary: The EmailPopupDocument class manages pop-up email documents and their related operations.
purpose: To handle email document pop-ups including creation, deletion, and search functions.
fields: ID: int - Identifier for the email popup document.
FileName: string - Name of the file associated with the document.
FilePath: string - Path to the file.
Checked: Boolean - Indicates whether the document is checked.
business_rules: Email data is processed through splitting and parsing to handle operations like deletion.
system_behavior: Processes email document operations like searching and deletion with error handling for IO operations.
